handback.title: Card and branch updates find checks by shown names
handback.summary: In an adopter's repo, the card and branch updates must find Dokima's checks by the names GitHub shows there.
handback.user_story: In an adopter's repo, the card shows Dokima's checks passing, and failing pull requests are not updated.

acceptance_criteria.text: When all tests passes in an adopter's repo, the card's Definition of Done shows Test suite passed.
acceptance_criteria.words: the card, which reads the check runs by plain name (e.g. `all tests`), so its Definition of Done never shows them passing

edge_cases.case: The check failed: the card shows Test suite failed.

acceptance_criteria.text: When Acceptance criteria passes in an adopter's repo, the card's Definition of Done shows Acceptance tests passed.
acceptance_criteria.words: the card, which reads the check runs by plain name (e.g. `all tests`), so its Definition of Done never shows them passing

edge_cases.case: The check failed: the card shows Acceptance tests failed.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a criterion's own check passes in an adopter's repo, the card shows that criterion passed.
acceptance_criteria.words: Fix: both find a check by the name GitHub shows, plain in Dokima's own repo and prefixed in an adopter's

edge_cases.case: The criterion's check failed: the card shows it failed.

acceptance_criteria.text: When all tests failed on a pull request's head in an adopter's repo, branch updates leave it behind main.
acceptance_criteria.words: the branch updates (uptodate), which look for the same plain names before bringing a pull request up to date

edge_cases.case: All tests passed: the pull request is still brought up to date.

raises.label: Criterion checks too
raises.text: Each criterion's own check is prefixed too, so the card misses it. Fix that here as well? The plan does.
raises.evidence: `dokima/card.py` `checks_by_key` wants names starting `N.k · `; adopters' start `dokima / acceptance-criteria / `.

raises.label: Doubt: overlaps open issues
raises.text: This overlaps #785 and #786, which move these names into settings. Should they keep only their other asks? Assumed yes.
raises.evidence: #785: card finds checks by settings names; #786: updates wait on all tests by settings name.
